prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Sanctuary Arrival Screen: Insert a new arrival staging screen 'new_desktop_sanctuary' immediately after the waiting screen to celebrate pet rendering completion. (why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), making an explicit arrival celebration crucial before entering home intro.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Control Flow: Introduce a two-screen walkthrough flow (new_control_overview and new_command_sheet) teaching users key pet controls and commands. (why: Three support emails noted confusion after onboarding on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Device Account Sync Status Hint: Add an explicit sync reassurance text hint component to the sign-in screen confirming pet retrieval security. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Quality Diagnostic Checklist: Add a photo requirements checklist component to upload_photos screen to guide users on optimal image inputs. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing bad rendering outputs.)
4: [home, notification] Background Pet Assembly Ready Alert: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and real-time generation tracking on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a high mean duration of 2336s, leading users to leave the desktop app unattended.)
5: [finish, layout] Full Bleed Desktop Mascot Welcome Layout: Switch the home_intro screen to a full_bleed layout featuring a prominent animated mascot component. (why: Finish stage completion drops to 64.8%, requiring a visual and immersive onboarding conclusion.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion Journey Path Selection Headline Refresh: Refresh copy on choose_path screen emphasizing instant adoption vs. custom pet creation flexibility. (why: 16.2% of users drop off at choose_path with a long mean duration (514s), signaling hesitation.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Split Column Sign-in Account Protection Layout: Change sign_in screen layout to split with a highlighted badge component confirming account data safety. (why: Account safety concerns and missing pet reports create drop-offs during sign-in.)
